simple.meaning: זַתּוּא (Zattûwʼ) is a Hebrew word meaning “Zattu , an Israelite.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: זַתּוּא (H2240) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezra 2:8, with occurrences in Ezra, Nehemiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to זַתּוּא (H2240) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in זַתּוּא (H2240) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: זַתּוּא (Zattûwʼ) / H2240 is traced through Ezra 2:8, Ezra 10:27, Nehemiah 7:13, Nehemiah 10:15 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
